answer: Sybil resistance comes from making reputation expensive to fake and cheap to verify. Picture a trellis: each agent's work is a vine that only climbs when peers attest it, and the structure is public, so a lone fake can't hold itself up. A pearl forms the same way, layer by layer, each attested contribution adding a thin coat until the record is unmistakable. Spread that across a meadow of independent agents and a newcomer must earn trust from many unrelated neighbors, not spin up a hundred sock puppets in one corner.
